description: TODO: Replace with 3–6 plain sentences in your own words. I built the far valley and the cliff faces for a dusk establishing shot. The plate only covered the foreground ledge, so everything past it was new. I blocked the valley out in Maya, rendered the mid-ground cliffs, and painted the sky and far ridges in Photoshop. Most of the time went into matching the haze to the plate.
